messages.content: I have come down with a head cold this week, took 2 days off running.
Rest was the right call. Two days off for a head cold will not hurt your marathon build.
My physio cleared my calf on Wednesday, so that is good news.
Great to hear the physio cleared the calf on Wednesday.
I cut my long run from 28k down to 20k because of the cold.
Sensible. Dropping the long run from 28k to 20k while ill protects recovery.
Sleep has been rough, only 5 to 6 hours a night while sick.
Prioritize sleep as you recover; 5 to 6 hours is not enough for adaptation.
Should I still do the tune-up race on 1998-09-20?
Let us see how the cold clears over the next few days before deciding.
OK, I will keep you posted on how I feel.
Please do. Keep hydration up and let the cold pass fully.
One more thing, my ferritin was the concern earlier. Should I keep the iron going?
Yes, keep the iron supplementation consistent; we will recheck ferritin at your next blood panel.
Will the missed sessions hurt my marathon prep?
A few easy days off this early will not derail the marathon build. Consistency over the full block matters more.
Rest up, and message me once the head cold clears so we can slot the long run back in.
